description: Change of Use from HMO (Class C4) to residential children's care home for up to four children (Class C2)
decision_conditions: <p>Insufficient information has been provided to demonstrate the proposal would address an identified local need for a proposed children’s care home and that the development is located within the community it is intended to serve, which is required. The lack of a legal agreement to secure first refusal for child placements for the London Borough of Harrow would not ensure that the needs of local childcare would be addressed. As such, the proposed change of use would be inappropriate for this site and contrary to the relevant provisions of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies H8A and H12 of the London Plan (2021), and Policy HO7e and Strategic Policy 03(7) of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).</p>

<p>Insufficient information has been provided to demonstrate that the proposed change of use of the site from its existing use to a children care home would have no significant adverse noise and disturbance to the detriment of the amenities of neighbouring occupiers at 7 and 11 Beechwood Avenue, contrary to Policies D3, D13 and D14 of The London Plan (2021) and Policies GR1C and HO7e and Strategic Policy 01 of the&nbsp;Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).</p>

<p>The proposal would result in the loss of an existing large house of multiple occupation of reasonable standard and no justification or reprovision has been provided to demonstrate that this loss is acceptable. The development would therefore result in an unwarranted reduction in the Borough’s housing stock, contrary to the relevant provisions in the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies H8A and H9D of the London Plan (2021) and Strategic Policy 03 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).</p>
